scientific_integrity: Proof uses source existence theorem and proves two-sided endpoint power comparisons by a stopped tilted multiplicative-walk argument. Auxiliary finite arithmetic checker is not an infinite proof. Claims are limited to displayed parameters and quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the unique non-atomic stationary measure of two-map AM systems with positive endpoint Lyapunov exponents and constant selection probabilities. Does not assert convergence of normalized endpoint masses, optimal comparison constants, global Hausdorff dimension, or an independently confirmed publication-priority claim.
title: Sharp endpoint mass laws and inverse-moment thresholds for Alsedà–Misiurewicz stationary measures
